Definition: probably of foreign origin; Spania, a region of Europe:--Spain.
BiblicalUsage: Spain is the far edge of Paul's map. Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you, he writes to Rome, and again, when I have sealed this fruit to the saints at Jerusalem, I will come by you into Spain. He never says whether he got there, only that he meant to go.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's Spain shows a gospel that will not stay home: the far west was on his heart, and I hold that the mission always looks further than the last town.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
